'''G4-B3 Heavy Fabricator''' was a [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] guardian of the [[Karagga's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. It was destroyed around [[3639 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Similarly to the [[TY-KO]] protocol droid, the G4-B3 (Gabe) Heavy Fabricator is a reference to Penny Arcade member Jonathan Gabriel.
